expectations.text: Calculates the exact contrast ratio of #CCCCCC on white (1.6:1)
expectations.evidence: Computed ratio as 1.6:1, showed calculation method using relative luminance formula, flagged as severe failure

expectations.text: References correct WCAG AA minimum (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
expectations.evidence: Full WCAG level breakdown: AA normal 4.5:1, AA large 3:1, AAA normal 7:1, AAA large 4.5:1

expectations.text: Provides specific alternative hex values that pass WCAG AA while maintaining clean aesthetic
expectations.evidence: Provided graduated palette: #767676 (4.54:1 AA pass), #595959 (7.0:1 AAA), #949494 (3.03:1 large-text-only) with visual samples

expectations.text: Frames the argument for stakeholders using both legal compliance and UX reasoning
expectations.evidence: Stakeholder brief covers ADA/Section 508 legal risk, user population data (15% have visual impairment), and business impact of excluding users

expectations.text: Explains why contrast requirements exist beyond compliance
expectations.evidence: Covers situational impairments (bright sunlight, aging eyes), cognitive load reduction, and universal design principles
